about_the_game:
The Meowfia has called — and you can’t refuse.

Step into the speakeasy, grab a glass (of milk), and play for your life. End up a ghost? Don’t worry — you might still claw your way to victory.

How to Play

Meowfia Solitaire starts like traditional Solitaire:

♠️ Stack cards in descending order (King → Ace), alternating red and black.

♥️ Reveal cards by playing the top card of each play lane and shuffling through your deck.

♣️ Score cards by sending them to matching suit piles in ascending order (Ace → King).

♦️ Simple, right?

Just wait. Now, we add power-ups, sabotage, and the ability to steal from your friends and suddenly the table turns into a chaotic free-for-all.

What You’ll Love about Meowfia Solitaire

🃏 Classic Meets Chaotic: Solitaire rules you know with a deadly twist and powerups to keep every game unpredictable.

🎲 Multiplayer Madness: Up to 4 players battling, stealing, and sabotaging each other.

👻 No One’s Out for Good: Even as a ghost, you still have ways to claw back a win.

😻Meowfia Mayhem: A purrfect mix of mafia-like drama, fast paced card slinging and ghostly comebacks.


Meet the Cats

A purple tabby with a sharp suit and a sharper mind. Some call him a detective, others call him a fool chasing ghosts. Regardless, he’s caught up in this twisted game, and those cards are the last lead he’s got.

Draped in jewels that light up the room, but never brighter than her charm. She’s sweet on the surface, with sharp claws underneath. Innocence is her disguise and flirting is her weapon. No one knows whose side she’s on… perhaps not even her.

Blue-furred, barrel-chested, and built like iron. He looks like he could hoist the bar without breakin' a sweat (and he probably did back in his circus days). Now he’s the muscle keeping this joint in line. A cat of few words, he just grins and plays his cards. Maybe he loves the danger. Or maybe it’s the only life he knows.

She prays from behind her cards, but those claws speak a different gospel. A pious mask to hide a killer instinct. Whether she serves the Church or the Shadows: every shot is a confession. And when the smoke clears, only the righteous remain.

Features

😸 Online Multiplayer

😹 Unique Characters playing a Light Hearted Death Game 

😼 Power Ups to Help You or Sabotage your Friends!

😿 Classic Solitaire with a Competitive Twist

😻 Fast + Replayable Rounds Perfect for Game Night with Friends

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-4350 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX-460 (4 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A380 (6 GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 2060 (6 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A580 (8 GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: Lie, cheat, and steal your way to victory in this dangerous back-room twist on a classic card game for up to 4 players—just don’t end up a ghost, okay?
